facade_assembly.name: Facade Assembly: Composition Grammar at Architectural Scale
facade_assembly.truth: Facades are assembly. Column orders, rhythm, hierarchy, fenestration, rustication — the vertical and horizontal syntax of architectural form. Where mosaics are arrays in stone, facades are CSG composition pointed at building parts.
facade_assembly.qfep_connection: Pure F: deterministic composition grammar. The principle taught by boolean_surfaces (union, intersection, difference) pointed at architectural primitives — column orders, bays, cornices, rustication. Six expression maps demonstrate what the assembly grammar does that a single rule cannot say in isolation.
learning_objectives: Column orders as compositional primitives: Doric, Ionic, Corinthian
Bay rhythm: regular vs syncopated; the horizontal syntax
Hierarchy: base / piano nobile / attic; the vertical syntax
Fenestration: window types and their semantic
Rustication as surface voice: smooth marble vs diamond bossing
Critique: when the principle is refused (Memphis, Superstudio), the refusal is legible only because the principle is
content: Facade_Assembly_Principle: The rulebook — column orders, rhythm, hierarchy, fenestration, rustication
Facade_Classical: The principle clean — symmetry, hierarchy, full column order
Facade_Baroque: The principle dramatized — rhythm becoming syncopation
Facade_Venetian_Gothic: The principle hybridized — Gothic vocabulary inside Italian rhythm
Facade_Rustication: The principle's surface — Naples diamond bossing
Facade_Florence_Marble: The principle surfaced — smooth Florentine marble (sibling of Naples diamond rustication; demonstrates surfaced-tag range)
Facade_NYC_Tenement: The principle modularized — same bay stacked
Facade_Critique: The principle refused — Superstudio + Memphis as anti-grammar

artifact_groups.rationale: The principle map. Small dense room in the spirit of Geometric_1 — labeled exemplars of column orders, bay rhythm, hierarchy, fenestration, rustication arranged so the player walks each principle move once. Pass-1 scaffold; artifacts to be authored next pass.
The canonical case. Symmetry, hierarchy, full column order. Pass-2 build.
The principle dramatized: Bernini-style colonnade, syncopated rhythm, dynamic ornament without losing hierarchy. Pass-3 build.
The principle hybridized: Gothic vocabulary (pointed arches, tracery) inside Italian bay rhythm. Two grammars compounding. Pass-3 build.
The principle's surface, voiced as Naples-style diamond rustication. Hierarchy preserved; texture carries the argument. Pass-3 build.

Surfaced-tag sibling of Naples diamond rustication. Demonstrates that the surfaced actualization has a vocabulary range — same axis-position, opposite material strategy (flatness/polish vs density/projection). Stamped 2026-05-14 from facade_placement.md rules.
The principle modularized: one bay design stacked five floors. Repetition without ornament. The grammar reduced to its skeleton. Pass-2 build (paired with Classical as opposite-pole expressions).
The principle refused: Superstudio's continuous monument and Memphis Group's totem-as-glyph. Anti-grammar legible only because the grammar is. Pass-4 build.
Synthesis chamber closing the sequence. Pass-1 scaffold.
